data.name: Premraj
data.gender_notes: Premraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prem means divine love and Raj means king, ruler or precious one. This name signifies a person who is deeply in love and holds a royal status or a precious value in someone's life. The name Premraj carries the meaning “Divine Love, Precious One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Premraj usually hope their child will grow to embody divine love, precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prem is a devotional term in Hinduism and signifies the supreme love for a deity. Raj symbolizes the divine king within us, the ruler of our inner world.
data.etymology: Premraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Love, Precious One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Premraj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Premraj" reflects the deep-rooted cultural significance of love and respect in the Hindu tradition. By combining two Sanskrit words, Prem and Raj, the name suggests a person who values and cherishes love and holds a position of high regard in society or in someone's heart. In Hinduism, love is considered a powerful emotion that can bring happiness and harmony to individuals and the world at large.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Premraj" lies in its suggests a person who is deeply immersed in the love of the divine. The name Prem signifies love for the divine, while the name Raj signifies royalty or being a ruler of one's own mind, emotions, and actions. Thus, a Premraj is someone who has surrendered their heart to the divine and has gained mastery over their mind and emotions. This kind of devotion and self-control leads to inner peace and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Premraj: A soul deeply immersed in divine love (Prem) and ruled by the king of love (Raj).
